title: If we care about plastic waste, why won't we stop drinking bottled water? ｜ 既然我们在意塑料垃圾，为何还不肯停止饮用瓶装水？

sents.en: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot worse than fill a bottle with water and sell it.
sents.cn: 尽管食品饮料行业以创新与选择为标志，但如果你想赚钱，把水装进瓶子卖掉算得上是相当稳妥的生意。

sents.en: A litre of tap water, the stuff we have cleverly piped into our homes, costs less than half a penny.
sents.cn: 一升自来水——我们巧妙地用管道引入家中的东西——成本不到半便士。

sents.en: A litre of bottled water can cost well over a pound, especially for something fancy that has been sucked through a mountain.
sents.cn: 而一升瓶装水的价格可能远超过一英镑，尤其是那种经过山体过滤的"高级"产品。

sents.en: Yet the bottled water market is livelier than ever.
sents.cn: 然而，瓶装水市场比以往任何时候都更活跃。

sents.en: It defies our increasing awareness of the harm plastics do to the environment and a broader, growing sense that something has to change.
sents.cn: 它无视我们日益增长的对塑料危害环境的意识，也无视一种更广泛、不断增长的"必须有所改变"的感受。

sents.en: Sales in the UK were worth a record £558.4 million this past year, an increase of 7%, according to the latest figures from the market analyst Kantar.
sents.cn: 根据市场分析机构凯度的最新数据，过去一年英国瓶装水销售额达到创纪录的5.584亿英镑，增长7%。

sents.en: Separate data from other analysts show that last year the British consumed more than 2.2 billion litres of bottled water, including "take-home" and "on-the-go" products.
sents.cn: 其他分析机构的独立数据显示，去年英国人消费了超过22亿升瓶装水，包括"带回家"和"即饮"产品。

sents.en: That's an annual rise in volume of 8.5%.
sents.cn: 这是销量上8.5%的年度增长。

sents.en: Environmental campaigners are struggling to understand why nations blessed with clean tap water grow only fonder of the bottle.
sents.cn: 环保活动人士正努力理解，为何那些拥有洁净自来水的国家反而越来越钟爱瓶子。

sents.en: "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic.
sents.cn: "这让我非常惊讶，"绿色和平组织政治顾问、反海洋塑料活动人士萨姆∙切坦-沃尔什说。

sents.en: "Public awareness has never been higher, but the message is not quite reaching all the people it needs to." Where it is heard, the message is causing concern.
sents.cn: "公众意识从未如此之高，但这一信息尚未完全触达所有需要听到它的人。"在人们听到之处，这一信息正引发担忧。

sents.en: Plastic water bottles require oceans of fossil fuels to make and ship.
sents.cn: 塑料水瓶的制造与运输需要海量化石燃料。

sents.en: Additionally, single-use plastics of all types are polluting our cities and seas.
sents.cn: 此外，各类一次性塑料正在污染我们的城市与海洋。

sents.en: Numerous documentaries have shown how plastic is ultimately killing wildlife.
sents.cn: 众多纪录片已展示塑料最终如何杀死野生动物。

sents.en: Moves against various plastics have gathered pace, from shopping bags to straws and plastic-lined coffee cups.
sents.cn: 抵制各类塑料的行动正在加速，从购物袋到吸管，再到内衬塑料的咖啡杯。

sents.en: Chetan-Walsh argues that bottled water is different because the alternatives are so obvious.
sents.cn: 切坦-沃尔什认为瓶装水有所不同，因为其替代方案如此显而易见。

sents.en: "If a product that is so nakedly unnecessary can exist then the whole system is failing," he says.
sents.cn: "如果一种如此明显多余的产品都能存在，那么整个体系都在失灵，"他说。

sents.en: Hope is not entirely out of reach.
sents.cn: 希望并非完全遥不可及。

sents.en: The rate of growth has begun to ease (sales were up 7% in the year, compared with 8% in the previous year).
sents.cn: 增长速度已开始放缓（今年销售额增长7%，而去年为8%）。

sents.en: But even if large numbers of people are quitting bottled water because of care for the environment, others are taking it up.
sents.cn: 但即便大量人群因关心环境而戒掉瓶装水，另一些人却在开始饮用。

sents.en: The introduction of the "sugar tax" on juices and soda drinks has pushed more people to bottled water, while health awareness has boosted its desirability.
sents.cn: 对果汁和苏打饮料开征的"糖税"，把更多人推向瓶装水，而健康意识的提升也增加了它的吸引力。

sents.en: Tap water consumption is growing at roughly the same pace (UK consumers still drink almost three times as much tap water as bottled water).
sents.cn: 自来水的消费正以大致相同的速度增长（英国消费者饮用的自来水仍几乎是瓶装水的三倍）。

sents.en: So the plastic tide only creeps higher.
sents.cn: 于是塑料的浪潮只是悄悄涨得更高。

sents.en: The industry is quick to point out that all its bottles are recyclable.
sents.cn: 业界迅速指出，其所有瓶子都可回收。

sents.en: "But collection rates are, at the most generous estimates, 56%, so the actual recycling rate will be lower than that," Chetan-Walsh says.
sents.cn: "但回收率最乐观的估计也只有56%，所以实际回收率会低于这个数字，"切坦-沃尔什说。

sents.en: And while bottles may be recyclable, very few are made of recycled plastic.
sents.cn: 而且尽管瓶子可回收，却极少由回收塑料制成。

sents.en: One water bottle company launched recycled half-litre "eco" bottles alongside its standard bottles.
sents.cn: 一家水瓶公司在标准瓶之外推出了回收的半升"生态"瓶。

sents.en: Another has pledged to use only recycled plastic across its range by 2025.
sents.cn: 另一家则承诺到2025年在其全系列中使用仅回收塑料。

sents.en: Chetan-Walsh believes in a ban on single-use bottles.
sents.cn: 切坦-沃尔什赞成禁止一次性瓶子。

sents.en: Bans do exist in some places.
sents.cn: 禁令在某些地方确实存在。

sents.en: Organisers of a famous music festival announced that water bottles will not be sold this summer.
sents.cn: 一个著名音乐节的组织者宣布今夏将不出售水瓶。

sents.en: San Francisco has banned them from city property and events.
sents.cn: 旧金山已禁止在其市政资产和活动中使用它们。

sents.en: Last year, the UK government set out plans to ban single-use plastic from its estate.
sents.cn: 去年，英国政府制定了从其资产中禁止一次性塑料的计划。

sents.en: Water bottlers, unsurprisingly, don't support bans.
sents.cn: 不出所料，瓶装水厂商不支持禁令。

sents.en: But they raise concerns about health rather than profit margins.
sents.cn: 但他们提出的关切是健康，而非利润率。

sents.en: Last month one chief executive of a water bottling company said that bans would "result in greater consumption of sugary drinks, adding to all the health dangers of obesity, diabetes and tooth decay".
sents.cn: 上个月，一家瓶装水公司的首席执行官说，禁令将"导致含糖饮料消费增加，加剧肥胖、糖尿病和蛀牙等种种健康危害"。

sents.en: Kinvara Carey, general manager of an association of the biggest bottled water manufacturers, cites a survey in which people were asked what they would do if bottled water were not available.
sents.cn: 最大瓶装水制造商协会的总经理金瓦拉∙凯里援引了一项调查，其中人们被问及若没有瓶装水会怎么做。

sents.en: "Forty-four per cent would buy another drink which is not great, 14% would go without, and 4.5% said they would find a fountain." she says.
sents.cn: "44%的人会买另一种并不健康的饮料，14%的人将忍渴不喝，4.5%的人说他们会去找饮水机。"她说。

sents.en: "The choice is important."
sents.cn: "选择很重要。"

sents.en: What if fountains were more numerous, and tap water more clearly available in cafes, restaurants and elsewhere?
sents.cn: 如果饮水机更多一些，咖啡馆、餐厅及其他场所的自来水更容易获得呢？

sents.en: Dozens of fountains are being installed in London.
sents.cn: 伦敦正在安装数十个饮水机。

sents.en: There are similar initiatives elsewhere.
sents.cn: 其他地方也有类似举措。

sents.en: Before plastic and the marketing that made people think they needed bottled water in the first place, fountains were an urban fixture.
sents.cn: 在塑料以及那种让人们最初以为自己需要瓶装水的营销出现之前，饮水机曾是城市的固定设施。

sents.en: Greenpeace, among others, is also pushing for a "deposit return" scheme.
sents.cn: 绿色和平组织等机构也在推动"押金返还"计划。

sents.en: This would mean tax on bottled water would be refunded to customers who returned the plastic for recycling.
sents.cn: 这意味着对瓶装水征收的税费将退还给把塑料瓶送回回收的顾客。

sents.en: Even if bottled water sales are growing slightly more slowly, the industry is racing to adapt to changing concerns and tastes.
sents.cn: 即便瓶装水销售增长略为放缓，该行业仍在竞相适应不断变化的关切与口味。

sents.en: Flavoured water is booming: sales of the sparkling variety shot up by 20%, according to the latest analyst data, Meanwhile, international water brands, as well as a range of new companies, are selling high-end reusable bottles.
sents.cn: 风味水正蓬勃发展：根据最新分析数据，气泡类风味水的销售额猛增20%。与此同时，国际水品牌以及一系列新公司正在销售高端可重复使用的水瓶。

sents.en: And if you must fill them with tap water, why not add flavouring?
sents.cn: 而如果你非得用自来水灌装它们，何不加点风味呢？

sents.en: As the owner of multiple sugary drink brands and bottled water, PepsiCo is facing challenges on health and environmental fronts.
sents.cn: 作为多个含糖饮料品牌和瓶装水的拥有者，百事公司正面临健康与环境方面的挑战。

sents.en: Last year, the company bought SodaStream (a drinks company that sells machines for making tap water bubbly and then consumers add flavours) for $3.2 billion.
sents.cn: 去年，该公司以32亿美元收购了SodaStream（一家出售将自来水打成气泡、再由消费者添加风味产品器械的饮料公司）。

sents.en: It also launched a range of fancy bottles that work with tap water and flavour packets.
sents.cn: 它还推出了一系列可与自来水和风味包搭配使用的花哨水瓶。

sents.en: The bottle is reusable.
sents.cn: 瓶子是可重复使用的。

sents.en: The packets?
sents.cn: 那些小包装呢？

sents.en: Not so much, and, yes, they are made of plastic, although the company invites users to post them back for recycling.
sents.cn: 没那么环保，而且，没错，它们由塑料制成，尽管公司邀请用户将它们寄回回收。

sents.en: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough.
sents.cn: 正如常见的情况，巧妙的营销能战胜理性；光有意识远远不够。

sents.en: "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick an analyst of bottled water.
sents.cn: "在关切、意图与改变的行为之间，总存在这种落差，"瓶装水分析师贾尔斯∙奎克说。

sents.en: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day.
sents.cn: "最好的例子是'每日五份'，即建议每天至少摄入五份水果和蔬菜。

sents.en: Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it." Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force, it will be up to consumers to not only demand change, but to act themselves.
sents.cn: 几乎人人都知道这一点，但我们中只有约15%的人做到了。"除非一项影响深远的瓶子禁令真正生效，否则既要要求改变、又要亲自行动，都将取决于消费者自己。
